I'm not able to reproduce this with the project you provided, so some more information would be helpful:
- Which LSP client are you using?
- What are your LSP settings in the Godot editor? (e.g. is the server running on a separate thread)
- Please provide an LSP trace from before the crash (the backtrace only shows that the crash is triggered by a completion request, but the parameters might be important to reproduce)

Haven't been able to repro recently, so I'll close this for now, but I'll reopen if it happens again and I can get an LSP trace.

I'm using `helix` and I do have the LSP server set to run on a separate thread.
